set.body:
Scope
Create one leakage-safe evidence layer shared by Transport and Replay.

Acceptance criteria
- Candidate posteriors support equal and declared non-equal priors.
- Energy engines receive a single temperature learned only in inner folds by held-out log loss.
- Likelihood engines may receive post-hoc calibration only when held-out reliability requires it.
- gaze_info_bits = log2(p_true / prior_true) is the default tidy endpoint.
- odds_bits is correctly prior-weighted and secondary.
- Candidate rank, top-1 probability, log loss, reliability curves, Brier score, candidate count/difficulty, and fold provenance are retained.
- Candidate-pool composition is frozen or explicitly sampled from a documented distribution.
- Tests prove no item, participant, warp, background, or calibration leakage across folds.
- Documentation states when average information gain is a log-score improvement versus when a mutual-information interpretation is justified.
set.title: GW-4 Build calibrated candidate evidence and information bits
